caption.raw_prose: A sun-drenched, narrow alleyway in a historic town, flanked by weathered, sandy-colored stone buildings. A dark, ornate wrought-iron lamppost extends from the right side, its metal arm and fixtures casting a shadow over the path. Above, the sky is a bright, clear blue. The alley is illuminated by a traditional streetlight hanging from the building to the right, and in the far distance, a small green potted plant is visible. The path, paved with stone and made darker by sunlight, leads toward a slightly taller building that rises in the center. Several windows and balconies are visible on the buildings, and a red tile awning is mounted on the left wall. Dark overhead wires create a dense tapestry along the right-hand wall. A blue mailbox is attached to the wall just below the light fixture. A dark, narrow space forms the central path through the alley.
